title: Returns Casebook: Returned-Payment Fees in a Storage Unit Catch-Up under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**Rule.** For a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the unit catch-up amount adds the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement's returned-payment fee twice where two settled draft attempts are recorded for the returned due date, the original draft and its re-presentment, both returned since the due date is still unpaid; once where one settled attempt is recorded for it; and nothing otherwise. Two or more settled attempts for the returned due date add the fee twice.

**Records read.** The draft attempts on the authorization whose due date is the returned due date (the agreement's oldest unpaid due date) and whose result is ACH settled; and the returned-payment fee of the agreement's unit class.

| Unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement | Returned-payment fee | Added for two settled attempts |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $30.00 | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $30.00 | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $30.00 | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $30.00 | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $35.00 | $70.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $35.00 | $70.00 |

### Cases (hypothetical, Bluegate Climate Plus unit)

| Draft attempts for the returned due date | Settled attempts counted | Added |
|---|---|---|
| Attempt 1 ACH settled, attempt 2 (re-presentment) ACH settled | 2 | $60.00 |
| Attempt 1 ACH settled, no re-presentment recorded | 1 | $30.00 |
| No attempt with a settled result | 0 | nothing |

A Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault unit in the first case adds $70.00; in the second, $35.00.
